## Summary

Describe the user-facing, technical, or safety outcome.

## Validation

- [ ] Ran `npm run check`
- [ ] Ran `npm run build` when frontend code changed
- [ ] Added or updated focused tests for changed behavior

## Guardrails

- [ ] This change does not add hiring decisions, automated rejection, ranking, or misconduct verdicts.
- [ ] This change uses neutral, human-review signal language.
- [ ] This change does not include candidate data, transcripts, storage URLs, credentials, or secrets.
- [ ] Documentation and `.env.example` are updated where the contract changed.
